segments.title: eTheorie Event Tracking
segments.subtitle: A walkthrough of where to find every event
segments.say: In this walkthrough we go platform by platform and click to every place where the website events can be found, so you can show them to your client.

segments.title: The events tracked on the site
segments.say: These are the actions tracked on the site. You will find the same actions in every platform we open next.

segments.show: this account holds two containers, one for the website and one for the server
segments.say: Go to tagmanager dot google dot com, search for Seascope, and open the Etheorie dot B E container. The second one, S G T M, is the server container. We open that one later.

segments.show: the green banner means the setup is published and live
segments.say: Click Versions. The green banner shows the container is published and live, with 68 tags.

segments.show: every tag name starts with the platform and ends with the action
segments.say: Go back to Workspace and click Tags. Every tag is named by platform and action, so anything is easy to find.

segments.action: Type STG - GA4 in the search box
segments.show: one Google Analytics tag for every action
segments.say: Type the platform name in the search box. Here are all the Google Analytics tags.

segments.show: one Meta tag for every action
segments.say: Type Meta, and you see every Meta tag.

segments.show: one TikTok tag for every action
segments.say: And the same for TikTok.

segments.action: Go back to the account list and open sGTM
segments.show: this server container runs on Stape. Stape only hosts it, the events are viewed here in Tag Manager
segments.say: Go back to the account list and open S G T M. This is the server container. It runs on Stape, but Stape only hosts it, so you always look at the events here in Tag Manager.

segments.show: the server container is published and live too
segments.say: Click Versions. The server container is also live, with 52 tags.

segments.show: from here every action is sent again from the server, to Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Conversions API and TikTok Events API
segments.say: In the server tags you see the same actions again. From here they are sent to Google Analytics, to Google Ads as conversions, and to the Meta Conversions API and the TikTok Events API. This makes the data more complete.

segments.show: purchase is set as the key event
segments.say: In Google Analytics, open the eTheorie property, click the gear icon for Admin, then Data display, then Events. Purchase is marked as the key event.

segments.show: every action from the website is arriving
segments.say: Click Recent events to see everything that is coming in, such as add to cart, begin checkout and add payment info.

segments.show: leads, sign ups, logins, pricing and purchases, 22 events in total
segments.say: Further down are the lead, sign up, login, pricing and purchase events. 22 events in total.

segments.action: Click Goals, then View all conversion actions
segments.show: this is where all conversions live
segments.say: In Google Ads, click Goals in the left menu, then View all conversion actions.

segments.show: Purchase is the only primary conversion, so campaigns bid on real sales
segments.say: Here are all conversion actions. Purchase is the only primary conversion, so the campaigns optimise on real sales.

segments.show: 11 conversion actions, 1 primary and 10 secondary for forms, sign ups and contact clicks
segments.say: The other conversions are secondary. They report forms, sign ups and contact clicks, without changing how the campaigns bid. There are 11 conversion actions in total.

segments.show: every event is active, from page view to purchase
segments.say: In Meta Business Suite, open Events Manager, click Datasets, then Etheorie Pixel. In Overview every event is listed as active, with how many times it was received.

segments.show: the TikTok pixel is connected and receiving events
segments.say: In TikTok Ads Manager, open Events Manager, click Data sources, then the Etheorie Pixel.

segments.show: the same events as Meta, all active
segments.say: Scroll down to the events table. The same events arrive here, and all of them are active.

segments.title: Everything is live
rows: all events arriving, purchase is the key event
segments.say: That is the full tour. Everything is published and live, and every platform receives the same events.
